module_role: Expanded multi-IO SPI (xSPI / QSPI / OSPI) controller or memory device: a controller drives SCLK + CS# and the bidirectional data lines IO0..IO7 to a serial NOR-flash / NAND / PSRAM device, issuing the instruction-address-dummy-data phase protocol with programmable dummy cycles, SDR/DDR signaling, the JEDEC flash command set, SFDP auto-configuration, and continuous-read / XIP.

integration_overview.host_bus_side: 8-bit register access at SoC-defined base address + 3-bit module offset.
integration_overview.interrupt_routing: Single SPI interrupt request line back to MCU interrupt controller; vector offset + priority chip-dependent.
integration_overview.host_side_register_spec: flash command set (0x00..0xFF) over the phase protocol; Status Register WIP/WEL for program/erase handshake; xSPI configuration registers for mode/latency/DQS/address-bytes.

interface_categories: SCLK / CS# — controller-driven clock and chip-select (shared with classic SPI).
Multi-IO data lines — IO0..IO3 (Quad) / IO0..IO7 (Octal), bidirectional.
DQS — optional source-synchronous read strobe (octal DDR).
xSPI register interface — protocol mode, dummy latency, DQS, address-byte count.
interconnect_topologies_supported: Point-to-point: one master + one slave (3-wire MOSI/MISO/SCK + optional SS)
Multi-slave: one master + multiple slaves (independent SS per slave)
Multi-master: multiple masters sharing MOSI/MISO/SCK with mode-fault arbitration
default_signal_values_when_omitted: CS# idle high (deselected); SCLK idle per CPOL; IO lines tri-stated when not driven; device powers up in single-IO (1-1-1) SPI mode with default addressing until reconfigured.

wait_mode.SPISWAI_1: SPI clock stopped; master aborts in-progress transmission until CPU re-enters run mode; slave continues if master still drives SCK.

low_power_modes.stop_mode: SPI inactive; master aborts in-progress transmission; slave continues if master still drives SCK.

spi_run_mode_when_SPE_clear: Module clock to SPI core gated off; register access still permitted.
soc_dependent_items: Number of data lines wired (1/2/4/8) and pin repurposing (/WP->IO2, /HOLD->IO3 in Quad).
Dummy-cycle configuration vs SCLK frequency (or SFDP auto-config).
Address-byte count (3 vs 4) and the chosen read command/mode.
Whether DDR/octal DDR with DQS is used.
Memory-mapped XIP window vs indirect access in the controller.
Chip-select count and per-device protocol mode.
topology_description: Point-to-point per chip-select: one controller (master) to one memory device. SCLK and CS# are controller-driven; IO0..IO7 are shared bidirectional data lines whose direction is set per command phase; octal DDR adds a device-driven DQS strobe.
